title_en: PhD Student · SJTU School of Medicine · AI4Rad Lab
title_cn: 博士研究生 · 交大医学院 · AI4Rad Lab
bio_en: PhD student at SJTU School of Medicine and a member of AI4Rad Lab. Research focuses on clinical radiology and medical imaging AI.
bio_cn: 交大医学院博士研究生，AI4Rad Lab 成员。研究方向为临床放射学与医学影像人工智能。

news_en.text: AbdomenNet — a foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on non-contrast CT, detecting 11 conditions and raising radiologists' mean AUROC from 0.812 to 0.924 — published in Nature Communications (IF 18.1).
C1 pedicle screw placement risks in ponticulus posticus — a CTA simulation study — published in Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research (IF 3.8).
LumbarSR — a paired clinical CT & micro-CT dataset for lumbar vertebra super-resolution — published in Scientific Data (IF 7.2).

news_cn.text: AbdomenNet —— 面向非增强 CT 急腹症诊断分层与分诊的基础模型，可检测 11 种急腹症并将放射科医生平均 AUROC 从 0.812 提升至 0.924，发表于 Nature Communications（IF 18.1）。
桥椎孔患者的 C1 椎弓根螺钉置钉风险——一项 CTA 回顾性模拟研究——发表于 Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research（IF 3.8）。
LumbarSR —— 配对临床 CT 与显微 CT 的腰椎超分辨率数据集，发表于 Scientific Data（IF 7.2）。
